# Handouts, including the ones Zoom hides {folder}
Zoom tucks the Resources button behind "More" when its window is narrow,
and RecordLah used to read that as "this webinar has no handouts". It now
opens it, and collects the files further down the list that it was
quietly skipping. When the host mentions the handouts in chat, it goes
and looks straight away instead of waiting for the next check.

# And it says when one does not turn up {danger}
If Zoom offers a handout and never sends it, you are told which one by
name rather than just how many arrived, and RecordLah tries that one
again a couple of minutes later.

# Search puts the closest answer first {search}
Type "hook up" and the lines that said it come before the ones that only
mention "hookup" — and the newest meeting comes before the oldest, which
it did not before.
